title: Paella Cooking class with amazing views
text: We had a wonderful evening with Fernando and the new friends who shared the cooking and dining experience with us.  A lovely venue at sunset with beautiful views of the city especially the Cathedral.  Everyone had a part in the step by step hands on cooking experience with masterful guidance by Fernando, who introduced himself to us as we did with him.  The meal, stories, and history were amazing.  Well worth an evening to learn some new skills and enjoy beautiful views and meet some new fellow travelers.  We might add - the Paella! author: bobhA2415XT

title: A highlight of our time in Sevilla
text: We loved this experience! Everything about it was perfect: great host, amazing views and excellent food! Fernando’s goal is to equip his students with the skills and knowledge needed to make good paella at home. Well, mission accomplished! I can’t wait to get home so I can try this out. Thanks for the experience Fernando! Highly recommend to others.
author: shanny_104

title: Delicious and educational
text: Excellent experience learning about the specifics of how to make a perfect paella. All questions answered. Delicious sangria. Beautiful patio location watching the sunset over the cathedral.
author: L9444JYjenniferg

title: Really fun time!
text: It was our last night in Sevilla and I’m so glad we did this! Fernando was an enthusiastic and knowledgeable host, had everything prepped and we lucked out with beautiful weather. The paella was delicious and the whole evening was a nice break from crowded tapas bars.  We met some lovely other travellers as well.  I would definitely recommend doing this on one of your nights in Sevilla!
author: Charlestontravelers4

title: A wonderful evening experience
text: What a fun experience! We did this for our 41st anniversary, what a treat!

author: David6677

title: Paella and Sangria cooking class in a beautiful setting!
text: This paella cooking class was one of our favorite activities in Seville!!  The process and technique was easy to follow and I’m confident we are going to be able to recreate this meal for our friends!!  The sangria in Spain is some of the best I’ve had and now we have the recipe for that too!   The scenery cooking on the patio with the sun setting and the cathedral in the background just got better and better.  10/10!!!
author: mariannehQ6288PO
